segments.name: Women's Health
segments.description: Markets SimpliDerm, a biologic matrix for soft tissue reconstruction, sold to healthcare facilities.
segments.evidence: SimpliDerm is the primary commercial product in our Women's Health segment, and the cardiovascular products reside in our Cardiovascular segment.

segments.name: Cardiovascular
segments.description: Markets its cardiovascular repair biologic matrix products ProxiCor, VasCure and Tyke to healthcare facilities.
segments.evidence: and the cardiovascular products reside in our Cardiovascular segment.

revenueModel.text: Healthcare facilities pay Elutia for its biologic matrix products, sold directly through independent sales agents.
revenueModel.evidence: These products are sold directly to healthcare facilities through independent sales agents.

changes.text: In 2025 the company sold its CIED Business and dropped the Device Protection segment, leaving Women's Health and Cardiovascular.
changes.evidence: With the divestiture of the CIED Business, the Company now operates in two segments.

changes.text: In 2023 the company sold its Orthobiologics Business, which was its entire Orthobiologics segment.
changes.evidence: The assets sold represented the entirety of our Orthobiologics segment.
